The road near our neighborhood has several deep potholes that make driving difficult.
Water supply has been irregular for the past two weeks.
Garbage bins in our area are overflowing and need to be emptied more frequently.
The bus service has become more convenient after the new route was introduced.
Several streetlights remain switched off after sunset.
The local hospital needs more seating space in the waiting area.
Our government school should provide better computer facilities for students.
Air quality has become poor because of increased traffic in the area.
The online portal made it easy to apply for a government certificate.
More police patrols are needed around the market during late evenings.
మా ప్రాంతంలో రోడ్డు పక్కన డ్రైనేజీ సరిగా పనిచేయడం లేదు.
తాగునీటికి తరచుగా అంతరాయం కలుగుతోంది.
చెత్త సేకరణ సమయానికి జరగడం లేదు.
మా ప్రాంతానికి బస్సులు చాలా తక్కువగా వస్తున్నాయి.
వీధి దీపాలు సరిగ్గా వెలగడం వల్ల రాత్రిపూట రోడ్డు స్పష్టంగా కనిపిస్తోంది.
अस्पताल में दवाइयाँ आसानी से उपलब्ध नहीं हैं।
हमारे स्कूल के आसपास की सड़क पर बहुत अधिक धूल है।
बिजली कटौती के बारे में पहले से सूचना देने पर लोगों को सुविधा होगी।
The public park needs more benches and shaded areas.
The municipal office staff explained the application process clearly.
